title: Open problems are determined from inside while their proofs stay out of reach

statements.text: Read from the genealogical projection, the Riemann Hypothesis determines yes, the Collatz conjecture determines descent, Goldbach determines yes, Navier-Stokes smoothness determines no, and P versus NP is a gap in kind. In each case the structural-functional proof boundary persists, and that gap is the object of study.

sources.quote: The Riemann Hypothesis may determine yes under the genealogical projection while the structural-functional proof-boundary persists.
